errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Брой автомобили“
errors.evidence: The y-axis label in the figure is „Брой автомобили“, but the chart combines counts and percentages; the generated description treats the vertical axis as if it only represents vehicle counts and omits the percentage scale shown by the orange bars/legend.

The description does not mention the separate percentage values shown by the orange series or explain that the chart effectively contains two measures, including the percent of total, alongside the count axis.

The figure shows a legend at the bottom identifying the blue and orange series, but the description does not explicitly describe the legend as a visual feature or note the chart title text visible in the image.
